author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Eighty! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

An unholy assembly of two GW Skirmish Games; Wyrdcry puts the simple move-fight Action system of Warcry to work in the City of The Damned. Rolling out with Warbadns for Human Mercenaries and Clan Eshin Night Runners (I may give this a try with my City of Ash box!); WYRDCRY is free to download and let's you use your classic miniature collection (or new one from Spearhead) in the seemingly abandoned Age of Sigmar Skirmish ruleset. Let's check it out!

Check out the FREE Rules, Campaign Section and Warband lists HERE https://jomblrverse.itch.io/wyrdcry
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 080 - WYRDCRY by jomblrverse
